trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression dividing the two lobes with a sharp interior vertex angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary with high-frequency jagged peaks and valleys of varying pixel-amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature mapping along the lateral leading edges tapering toward the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the distal fluke tips and sporadically along the leading edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged structural irregularities and protrusions located at the distal lobe tips.
